parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood. It provides the overall shape and support for the shelves and door.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the entire cabinet structure, holding the shelves and door in place, and ensures stability and durability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is a flat horizontal board inside the cabinet, made of plywood, used to support stored items.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the cabinet space into sections and supports objects placed on it.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed but can sometimes be adjustable depending on the design.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is the front panel made of solid wood, attached to the frame with hinges, and includes a handle for opening.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the cabinet interior and protects stored items from dust and view.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its hinges to open and close.
